_comment: Captured terminal screens (herdr agent read --source visible) from supervised real-agent runs on 2026-10-24. Each entry is classified with `herdr agent explain --file <screen> --agent <agent> --json` by ../test_fixtures.py when HERDR_TEST_BINARY points at a built binary. File mode has no OSC title/progress input, so idle expectations rely on visible footer rules.

'Folder access / Trust this folder?' dialog; the bundled trust_directory rule already matched it
idle came from the OSC title in the live run; file mode has no visible idle rule for Codex, so no state is asserted (recorded for drift tracking)

'Approaching rate limits' model-switch picker shown after a completed turn; Enter selects the highlighted 'Switch to ...' choice. Before codex manifest 2026.10.24.1 it classified as idle (default fallback; the live OSC title also reads idle), so a prompt would have been typed into the picker
